ValidationRule.description: Method value is required when task type is Core sales task and Sub type is Discovery Call, WO Business Profile, WO Proposal or WX Proposal
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK(TEXT(NSP_Method__c)), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Core Sales Task"), OR(ISPICKVAL(NSP_Task_Subtype__c, "Discovery Call"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Task_Subtype__c, "WO Business Profile"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Task_Subtype__c, "WO Proposal"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Task_Subtype__c, "WX Proposal")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please choose a value for method when the Task type is Core Sales Task and Sub type is Discovery Call, WO Business Profile, WO Proposal or WX Proposal
